sources.title: Taylor and Taylor2009: Seed ferns from the late Paleozoic and Mesozoic: Any angiosperm ancestors lurking there?
sources.notes: Full review HTML read; corrected inventory title. Axis around5cm, subopposite stalked multiovulate cupules, near-circular compression, recurved proximal lip directed toward attachment. Sagenopteris and Caytonanthus association does not establish measured complete habit. Later2021 CT work means old no-anatomy statements are not treated as current absolute.

sources.title: Shi et al.2021: Mesozoic cupules and the origin of the angiosperm second integument
sources.notes: Actual official Extended Data Figure6 pixels and caption inspected, not full paywalled article. Panels a–g flattened axes/cupules; h–i Harris drawings; j–l Daohugou fossils. Two ranks, recurved cupules, broad proximal lip, many seeds, no individual subtending bracts; do not copy other taxa in paper. 3D depth and pose are artistic, not measured from compression.
